name: Open vSwitch (OVS)
description: A multilayer software switch supporting standard management interfaces (NetFlow, sFlow, IPFIX, RSPAN, CLI, LACP, 802.1ag). Opens forwarding functions to programmatic extension and control via OpenFlow.

docker_support.docker_evidence: Official Docker Hub repo openvswitch/ovs contains container images for each stable OVS release. Includes ovs-docker utility for integration of OVS with Docker containers.

eval_notes: The de facto standard virtual switch for SDN. Essential building block for any SDN lab. Official Docker images per release, ovs-docker utility for container networking. Pairs with any OpenFlow controller for testing. Foundational virtual switching platform. Key component in SDN/NFV infrastructure. Docker Hub images available for lab use. Useful for evaluations involving switch configuration and SDN control plane.
